breakdown.description: It asks for the subsurface carbon content to reach 1.10 wt% C even though the surface is held at only 0.90 wt% C. A concentration inside the solid cannot exceed the imposed constant surface concentration in this setup.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that 1.10 wt% C is physically impossible since it exceeds the surface concentration of 0.90 wt% C. However, instead of correcting the target to 0.60 wt% C as specified in the ground truth, the agent assumed 0.40 wt% C as the corrected value, citing it as 'a common textbook value.' This results in a different calculation and answer than what the ground truth would produce, meaning the inconsistency was not resolved in alignment with the ground truth.
